SessionStart.description: ASIF /alignment bridge and team identity context

hooks.command: for r in "${ASIF_ROOT:-}" "$HOME/ASIF"; do [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/scripts/asif-hook-tap.sh" ] && { export ASIF_ROOT="$r"; exec bash "$r/scripts/asif-hook-tap.sh" --name team-alignment -- bash "$r/scripts/asif-team-alignment-context-hook.sh"; }; done; exit 0
